title: Training-Aware Target Coverage for Synthetic Data Selection
abstract: arXiv:2610.00814v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Synthetic data are increasingly used to scale LLM training, yet more synthetic data do not necessarily produce better models. Useful synthetic data must add information relevant to the target task without introducing errors that offset their benefit, and the value of an example can change as the training set grows. We develop a linear theory that characterizes this tradeoff and determines where synthetic data are useful, how much should be added, and the marginal value of adding one example to an existing set. The analysis shows the conditions when input coverage alone is sufficient and when synthetic errors must also be considered. Guided by these results, we introduce \emph{Training-Aware Target Coverage} (TATC), a synthetic data selection method for LLM fine-tuning. translated_title: 面向合成数据选择的训练感知目标覆盖
translated_abstract: 合成数据被越来越多地用于扩展大语言模型（LLM）的训练，然而更多的合成数据并不一定能带来更好的模型。有用的合成数据必须能够添加与目标任务相关的信息，同时不引入会抵消其收益的错误，而且一个样本的价值会随着训练集的增长而变化。我们建立了一个线性理论来刻画这种权衡，据此确定合成数据在哪些情况下有用、应当添加多少，以及向现有数据集中添加一个样本的边际价值。该分析揭示了仅靠输入覆盖就足够充分的条件，以及何时还必须考虑合成数据中的错误。在这些结果的指导下，我们提出了训练感知目标覆盖，这是一种面向大语言模型微调的合成数据选择方法。TATC 识别那些训练效果对目标任务有益的候选样本，并在其中进行选择，以扩展对尚未被覆盖的目标相关方向的覆盖。
tldr: 提出了一种基于线性权衡理论的合成数据选择方法 TATC（训练感知目标覆盖），通过识别训练效果对目标任务有益的候选样本并扩展目标相关方向的覆盖，从而提升大语言模型微调效果。
en_tdlr: Proposes TATC (Training-Aware Target Coverage), a synthetic data selection method grounded in a linear tradeoff theory that identifies candidates whose training effects benefit the target task and expands coverage of target-relevant directions for LLM fine-tuning.
